paragraphs.text: You stagger to the roadside, breathing hard. Your legs feel weak on the solid ground. As you run, you risk a glance over your shoulder. The bear seems to have thought better of its pursuit and is moving off through the trees. You pause to catch your breath.
If your back has been hurt, you cannot effectively administer First Aid, particularly while a hostile bear is in the area. It will have to wait. Go to 79.
